name: Previous college coursework
description: Courses completed at an accredited college may be evaluated for transfer credit and degree applicability.
evidence_requested: Official transcript; course descriptions or syllabi when requested; institution and completion dates.
next_step: Request an official transfer-credit evaluation and review the result with a BMCC advisor.

name: AP or recognized examinations
description: Qualifying AP, CLEP, IB, AICE, DSST, or DLPT results may be evaluated under BMCC and CUNY policies.
evidence_requested: Official score report or official transcript showing examination name, date, and score.
next_step: Send official examination records to BMCC Admissions and confirm how any evaluated credit applies to the selected degree.

name: ACE or NCCRS reviewed learning
description: Structured non-collegiate learning reviewed by ACE or NCCRS may carry a credit recommendation for college evaluation.
evidence_requested: Official ACE or provider transcript; exact training title; provider; completion date; ACE/NCCRS recommendation when available.
next_step: Ask BMCC CPL staff to evaluate the official record against program requirements.

name: Employer or industry training
description: Substantial workplace, union, continuing-education, or industry training may be eligible for review when college-level learning can be documented.
evidence_requested: Completion certificate; curriculum or syllabus; contact hours; learning outcomes; assessments; provider information.
next_step: Contact BMCC CPL staff before assuming the training will earn or replace any credit.

name: Military education and training
description: Military training and examinations may be reviewed using official military records and recognized credit recommendations.
evidence_requested: Joint Services Transcript or CCAF transcript; relevant service records; examination score reports when applicable.
next_step: Request official military records and ask BMCC CPL staff which evaluation route applies.

name: Licenses and professional certifications
description: Current licenses and industry credentials may be reviewed when ACE, NCCRS, or an approved college evaluation supports college-level learning.
evidence_requested: Credential name and issuer; credential ID when safe to share officially; issue/expiration dates; official verification; exam or training documentation.
next_step: Check the credential in official CPL resources and request a BMCC evaluation before planning around possible credit.

name: Biliteracy or language proficiency
description: Recognized language examinations or documented advanced proficiency may create an examination or departmental-review pathway.
evidence_requested: Official language examination score; Seal of Biliteracy documentation if applicable; transcripts; proficiency records.
next_step: Ask BMCC Admissions or CPL staff which recognized examination or departmental process applies.

name: Portfolio or documented experiential learning
description: Some prior learning may be demonstrated through organized evidence, but portfolio availability varies by college, department, and program.
evidence_requested: Resume; relevant work samples; training records; role descriptions; learning narrative; evidence tied to course learning outcomes.
next_step: Ask BMCC CPL staff whether portfolio or faculty evaluation is available for the selected program before preparing a full portfolio.
